supplement_role: Numeric read bounds for a future independent consumer evaluation; original pre-production oracle and its expected answers remain immutable. This supplement was fixed after initial L1 production and before formal L2/L3/L4 authoring or any independent consumer execution. It is not retroactive evidence that numeric bounds existed before L1.
public_objective: Answer the reserved domain maintenance and boundary cases through actual Atlas ownership.index/read with progressive depth; no raw product source, other author output or reserved answer key.

shallow.scope: Select one relevant evidence artifact and reason about the selected source record; current evidence artifacts are coherent batches, and all returned batch bytes count even if only one record is used.

deep.scope: Read relevant evidence batches and domain guides as needed, with no whole-corpus dump. Limits include requests already used during the shallow phase of that case.

request_counting: Every issued index/read request counts, including HOLD, error and repeated calls. Returned body byte counts use UTF-8 of the actual returned body; full serialized responses are recorded separately. No bytes-to-token or cost conversion.
consumer_counting: One new context per independent consumer episode; no author or judge becomes consumer. Cases may share an episode only when the trace makes context reuse explicit and aggregate bounds are separately enforced.
unknown_usage: Host provider/model tokens, physical attempts and billing UNKNOWN unless directly exposed. No external paid provider calls.
bridge: Direct real ports when exposed, otherwise a faithful recorded request/response bridge with no enrichment. Instruction-only restrictions are reported as such; no technical isolation claim without enforcement evidence.
failure_rule: A failed or over-budget response remains a failed/pending case; corrections or changed bounds create a new linked evaluation, never overwrite this freeze.
